TextColorDark.role: Text on accent fills (TextBrushDark: selected rows, Play button)

MainColor.role: NormalBrush: scrollbar thumb, group box and combo box borders

MainColorDark.role: NormalBrushDark: tracks, splitters; check mark background

GlyphColor.role: Accent: icons, button text, focus and selection borders, selected-row fill

WindowPanelSeparatorColor.role: Window panel separator (unused by the Default theme files)

DataChangeNotifColor.role: Unsaved-data marker (unused by the Default theme files)

keep_literal.BlackColor: unchanged: pure black, not used by any Default theme style
keep_literal.WhiteColor: unchanged: pure white, not used by any Default theme style

NormalBorderBrush.role: Control borders (buttons, inputs, lists, window border when a dialog is open)

HoverBrush.role: Hover rectangle of list rows, menu items and sidebar items

gradients_replaced.ExpanderBackgroundBrush: bg.raised fading to transparent (was a blue gradient)
gradients_replaced.WindowBackgourndBrush: solid bg.canvas (was a blue gradient; the key keeps Playnite's spelling)

FlatcapChipBrush.role: Top panel buttons (was a 60% dark navy)

FlatcapSelectedBrush.role: Search results: hovered and selected row (was #003f59)

FlatcapBadgeBrush.role: Notification badge and empty-item markers (was OrangeRed)

FlatcapDangerBrush.role: Exit and remove icons, validation mark (was OrangeRed or Red)

FlatcapScrimBrush.role: Overlay on game covers (name, hover, uninstalled); was 60% or 67% black

GlyphColor.role: Accent: focus outline (first stop of SelectionBrush), icons, glow around the focused cover

GlyphLightColor.role: Light accent: second stop of SelectionBrush, hovered text and icons

SelectionLightColor.role: Outlines of fields and check boxes, scroll thumb, slider track

OverlayColor.role: Translucent layer over the art behind full-screen overlays

ControlBackgroundColor.role: Text boxes, filter fields, check boxes, resting list rows

ControlBackgroundColorDark.role: Focused or hovered controls, game titles on covers, tooltips, check mark background

TextColorDark.role: Disabled controls (Playnite also draws them at 50% opacity)

WarningBrush.role: Warning text (was a fixed salmon red)

MainBackgourndBrush.role: Window background (was a blue radial gradient; the key keeps Playnite's spelling)

OverlayMenuBackgroundBrush.role: Menus and dialogs (was a blue gradient)

TopBarBackgroundBrush.role: Top bar over the background art (same geometry as the original)

BottomBarBackgroundBrush.role: Bottom bar over the background art

GameDetailsBackgroundBrush.role: Game details panel fading in over the art

keep_literal.BlackColor: unchanged: pure black, used only for the shadow under the game title
keep_literal.WhiteColor: unchanged: pure white, not used by any Default Fullscreen style

gradients_replaced.MainBackgourndBrush: solid bg.canvas (was a blue radial gradient)
gradients_replaced.TopBarBackgroundBrush: bg.surface fading to 80% (was a blue gradient)
gradients_replaced.BottomBarBackgroundBrush: bg.surface fading to 80% (was a blue gradient)
gradients_replaced.GameDetailsBackgroundBrush: bg.canvas from clear to 93% (was a blue gradient)

FlatcapScrimBrush.role: Dimmed layer behind selection menus and over uninstalled covers (was #AA000000)
